subject: Helix Health - Performance pact & runbook for MAP (latency/throughput/TTFT, concurrency)
messages:
From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@helixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: scope for performance evaluation

Evelyn —

Thanks for the kickoff this morning. We chatted internally and want to lock down the exact performance gates before the PO. Two asks: 1) a short runbook we can use to validate latency/throughput/TTFT during our pilot, and 2) the workload slices (concurrency profile + input length distribution) you intend to run so our infra team can mirror load. Can you send a one-page acceptance matrix + the CSV of workload samples?

Sara
VP Product, Helix Health

> -Evelyn
> Director, Solutions Engineering

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Helix MAP — proposed acceptance matrix + workload slice CSV (draft)

Sara —

Attached are two artifacts as a starting point: helix_map_draft_v1.pdf (one-page acceptance matrix + runbook highlights) and helix_workload_profile.csv (sampleed input lengths and concurrency buckets). High-level summary below:

- Success criteria (MAP acceptance):
  * 95th percentile token generation latency <= 120ms at target concurrency profile
  * TTFT (time-to-first-token) <= 150ms for requests under 1k tokens
  * Sustained throughput: 350k tokens/minute on the Dedicated config described
  * No more than 0.25% error rate (generation failures/timeouts) over a 4-hour soak

- Workload slices (from CSV):
  * Slice A: 70% short queries (<=128 tokens), concurrency 50–80
  * Slice B: 20% medium (129–512 tokens), concurrency 20–30
  * Slice C: 10% long (512–2048 tokens), concurrency 5–10

- Runbook highlights:
  * Pre-run checklist: model pin, quantization profile, warmup trace, KV cache prefill
  * Test runs: 3 x 30-minute steady-state runs, 1 x 4-hour soak for error/availability
  * Post-run: token-level cost report + per-route latency histograms + trace for any TTFT spikes

If that aligns, Jonas and I will schedule the formal benchmarking run and share the runbook spreadsheet with your infra.

Attachments: helix_map_draft_v1.pdf, helix_workload_profile.csv

Best,
Evelyn
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Helix MAP — proposed acceptance matrix + workload slice CSV (draft)

Folks — quick alignment note before we hand to Helix:

1) The 95p latency target at 120ms assumes DedicatedQuarter configuration with 8xA10G/16GB instances and the optimized kernel set. If Helix opts for a smaller Dedicated tier, we should surface the equivalent SLOs (e.g., 95p 200ms on DedicatedSmall).

2) TTFT measurement: make sure infra team uses cold-start excluded metric (TTFT after model loaded and KV warmed). We'll include the exact Datapoint ID in the runbook.

3) For the 4-hour soak, propose capturing per-minute error counts and the full error trace for any minute with >3 failures.

I'll annotate the PDF and push a runbook checklist (runbook-checklist.xlsx) with the cluster config matrix. Priyom — can you prepare a short script we can share for generating the mixed-concurrency load from Helix's environment?

-Jonas
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Helix MAP — proposed acceptance matrix + workload slice CSV (draft)

Attaching the load generator snippet and notes in the runbook-checklist.xlsx. Key points:

- The script will replay the CSV and respect token-length buckets; it can run from Helix infra or from our Dedicated driver.
- We'll include a toggle for ‘KV prefill’ to ensure consistent TTFT baselines.
- Telemetry: the script emits per-request event with fields: request_id, slice, tokens_in, tokens_out, ttft_ms, latency_ms, error_code.

Evelyn — I added a short section on how to interpret the 95p vs p99 delta and recommended gating logic for canary vs final acceptance.

-Priyom
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@helixhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 14:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Final MAP run schedule & acceptance checklist (requested by Helix)

Sara —

Thanks for the quick review call earlier. Per our alignment, here's the final plan we will run next week:

- Schedule: kickoff run Wednesday 21 Jan 2026 09:00 PT; 3 x 30-minute steady runs then 1 x 4-hour soak starting 12:30 PT.
- Acceptance gating: must meet all of the following during the soak window:
  * 95p latency <= 120ms (DedicatedQuarter)
  * TTFT <= 150ms for <=1k token requests
  * sustained throughput >= 300k tokens/min (we agreed to lower to 300k to match Helix traffic pattern)
  * errors <= 0.25% total requests during soak
- Deliverables within 24h of run: runbook-checklist.xlsx with annotated telemetry, token-cost-report.csv, per-route latency histograms, and a short findings memo.

Attachments: runbook-checklist.xlsx

Please confirm this schedule or propose an alternate window. Once you confirm, procurement will accept the pilot PO and we will provision the Dedicated driver.

Best,
Evelyn
From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@helixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP run schedule & acceptance checklist (requested by Helix)

Evelyn —

Confirmed. We will be ready for Wednesday 21 Jan at 09:00 PT (we ran a brief internal check, everything looks good). Procurement has the PO and expects provisioning by Tuesday EOD. Two small notes: please include the Datapoint IDs you referenced for TTFT so our monitoring maps cleanly to yours, and please call out the fallback behavior in the runbook if the soak shows p99 > 400ms (we want the rollback trigger clearly written).

Sara

--
